Pree's ticket number is #8841. I replied in her thread in #central-random.

Tobias posted it in that channel on Oct 13 at 9:27. He said West yard Door 2 is still double-booking when flatbeds check in early at the kiosk, and that he'd flagged it on #8841 for support. I also warned her not to confuse it with #88412, an older Tansleigh Packaging ticket.

One part of my reply is a guess. Tobias's message names the "dealer account", not Marrow Fieldworks. I linked the two because of a January handoff digest: it says Marrow Fieldworks was Pree's dealer account and "changes hands" on Jan 5, but it doesn't say who took it over. I told Pree the account moved to Tobias on Jan 5 as if that were confirmed, and no source actually says so. Tobias can confirm it's the same account.

I only used sources Pree can see herself: #central-random, #central-team and the public team files.
